title.zh: 【英国 Aviva Investors 在 XRP Ledger 推出英镑流动性基金代币化份额】
title.en: 【英国 Aviva Investors 在 XRP Ledger 推出英镑流动性基金代币化份额】

current_state.zh: Aviva Investors launched a tokenized share class of its £22bn Sterling Liquidity Fund on the XRP Ledger, its second tokenized fund after July's USD version, with combined tokenized investments exceeding $116M including $66M from Aviva itself.
current_state.en: Aviva Investors launched a tokenized share class of its £22bn Sterling Liquidity Fund on the XRP Ledger, its second tokenized fund after July's USD version, with combined tokenized investments exceeding $116M including $66M from Aviva itself.
